name: smeltr
description: Local dashboard and ledger for a long-running 4K HEVC re-encode job

scripts.lint: bun run --sequential lint:js lint:js:syntax lint:py lint:py:syntax lint:sh lint:sh:staging lint:ci format:js:check lint:page
scripts.lint:js:syntax: for f in web/*.js tests/visual/*.mjs; do bun build --no-bundle "$f" --outfile /dev/null >/dev/null || exit 1; done
scripts.lint:sh:staging: shellcheck -x -S error staging/*.sh && (shellcheck -f gcc -x -S warning staging/*.sh || echo 'advisory above error level: staging/ mirrors the live X9 scripts -- fix on the drive, then copy back')
scripts.preinstall: case "$npm_config_user_agent" in bun/*) ;; *) echo 'smeltr: this repo runs on bun -- use `bun install`, not npm/yarn/pnpm' >&2; exit 1 ;; esac
scripts.system-check: bun run --sequential format:check lint test build

*.{js,mjs}: sh -c 'for f; do bun build --no-bundle "$f" --outfile /dev/null >/dev/null || exit 1; done' --
lint-staged.{smeltr,.husky/[a-z]*,**/*.sh}: sh -c 'w=; e=; for f; do case $f in staging/*) e="$e $f";; *) w="$w $f";; esac; done; [ -z "$w" ] || shellcheck -x -S warning $w || exit 1; [ -z "$e" ] || { shellcheck -x -S error $e && (shellcheck -f gcc -x -S warning $e || echo "advisory above error level: staging/ mirrors the live X9 scripts -- fix on the drive, then copy back"); }' --
